messages:
Ava: Customer reporting `go get github.com/acme/private@v1.2.0` fails with 403 from GOPROXY. They think our Go SDK v1.3.0 caused it because it pulls a `replace` in downstream go.mod. Ticket #INC-5021
Sam: Can you paste the exact error they see?
Ava:
```
go: github.com/acme/private@v1.2.0: unexpected status (403 Forbidden) fetching https://proxy.golang.org/github.com/acme/private/@v/v1.2.0.info
```
They can fetch public deps fine, only this one errors.
Jordan: 403 from proxy.golang.org usually means the proxy can't access that repo. Do they have any `replace` or GOPRIVATE settings?
Ava: Their go.mod includes a replace:
```
replace github.com/acme/private => github.com/acme/private v1.2.0
```
They also say CI sets `GOPRIVATE=github.com/acme/*` but local dev doesn't.
Sam: If GOPROXY is set to proxy.golang.org only, the proxy will reject private modules with 403. What is their GOPROXY/GOPRIVATE env locally?
Ava: They had `GOPROXY=https://proxy.golang.org` (no direct) and no GOPRIVATE locally. CI was different. They say the replace in their dep causes `go` to attempt fetching via proxy and fail.
Jordan: That matches. `replace` can alter resolution but the root cause is the proxy blocking private modules. Two quick fixes: set `GOPRIVATE=github.com/acme/*` in env, or `GOPROXY=https://proxy.golang.org,direct` so `go` falls back to git. Also `GIT_TRACE=1 go get ...` helps debug.
Ava: I repro'd locally by setting GOPROXY to proxy.golang.org and got the same 403. Workaround `GOPRIVATE=github.com/acme/* go get github.com/redwood/inference-go@v1.3.0` fixed it for them.
Sam: From our side, we should avoid shipping go.mod with public releases that contain replaces pointing at private repos. Can we add a release CI check?
Maya: Agreed — tagging a replace to a private module in a public release is risky. I'll add a job to release CI to scan go.mod for replace entries that match private hosts and fail the build.
Ava: Escalating to eng-platform for CI guard. Customer accepted the workaround and unblocked their install. I'll update ticket #INC-5021.
ci-bot: [warning] release preflight: candidate v1.4.0 scan found `replace github.com/acme/private` in go.mod — marking WARNING.
Sam: I'll draft a short KB for support: repro steps, error snippet, the two fixes (`GOPRIVATE` or `GOPROXY=direct`), and guidance for maintainers to avoid private replaces in public tags. :memo: :shipit:
Jordan: Also mention `go env -w GOPRIVATE=...` for persistent fix and add the `GIT_*` debug hint in the KB.
Ava: Leaving next actions in the ticket: 1) KB draft, 2) CI release check, 3) follow up with customer to confirm CI change.
